author: Kamil Mete Yalcinkaya
description: Detects a value being written to a Run key where the payload points at a script interpreter or a binary in a user-writable directory. Writing to Run keys is normal for installed software; the combination with a scripting host or a temp path is not.
false_positives: Installers that place updater shims under ProgramData. Confirm the publisher of the target binary before escalating.
name: Autorun Registry Key Written With a Suspicious Payload
note: Investigation fields: registry.path, registry.data.strings, process.name, user.name
query: ((registry.path : "*\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*" or registry.path : "*\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*" or registry.path : "*\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\Shell Folders\\Startup*") and (registry.data.strings : "*powershell*" or registry.data.strings : "*wscript*" or registry.data.strings : "*cscript*" or registry.data.strings : "*mshta*" or registry.data.strings : "*rundll32*" or registry.data.strings : "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" or registry.data.strings : "*\\Users\\Public\\*" or registry.data.strings : "*\\ProgramData\\*"))
